title: Dropdown control and menu
guidance: Inset the arrow; use a rounded, bounded option panel with restrained depth. Preserve native semantics and keyboard operation; apply the pattern across dropdowns.
Use a faint divider between each option in the rounded menu. Preserve inset arrow, selected/hover distinction and native keyboard semantics across every dropdown.

decisions.title: Native select with a rounded supported picker
decisions.reason: Keep native keyboard/input semantics. Modern base-select renders a padded rounded menu with a restrained shadow and inset arrow. Unsupported browsers keep their platform picker.

decisions.title: Space before arrow keys
decisions.reason: The actual keyboard check opens with Space, moves with ArrowDown, then commits with Enter.

decisions.title: Subtle option separation
decisions.reason: A faint 1px shared-border divider separates every adjacent option in supported base-select pickers, without replacing native interaction or adding a second menu implementation.
